$comment: Owner-reviewed source usage policy. ONLY the project owner edits licenseStatus / can* / autoPublishAllowed, after reading each source's terms.
A model, an API response or an indexer never grants rights. Unknown hosts are treated as unreviewed (fail closed).
Bump policyVersion whenever a permission changes; auto-publish benchmarks are tied to it.

feedAccess is separate from rights: 'allowed' only permits fetching a feed for candidate METADATA (title, link, date). It never grants reuse; licenseStatus still gates every question. Set it only after reading the publisher's terms (record basis + reviewedBy + reviewedAt).

sources.name: Grand Theft Wiki
sources.notes: Evidence for documented in-game events only; licenseStatus stays unreviewed. CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported (https://www.grandtheftwiki.com/Grand_Theft_Wiki:Licensing) applies only when wiki TEXT is reused or adapted: then a prominent link to the source page, a 'from Grand Theft Wiki' credit, a pointer to the page history (authors), the licence name/link, a modification notice and CC BY-SA licensing of the adapted text are required — that attribution UI does not exist yet. GTA questions therefore use Independent Factual Summaries (original wording, wiki page linked and named as the source). Rockstar's in-game text/images are not covered by the wiki licence and are never reused.

sources.name: Rockstar Games (Newswire and official GTA pages)
sources.notes: Registered 2026-11-25 as a verification source for documented GTA content (Newswire posts, official GTA VI pages) in the curated question bank (npm run bank:import). licenseStatus stays unreviewed: no reuse rights. Rockstar text, images, logos, trailers and screenshots are never reused; questions are human-reviewed Independent Factual Summaries in original wording that link to the page.

sources.name: GTA Base
sources.notes: Registered 2026-11-25 as a verification source (mission database) for documented GTA events in the curated question bank. licenseStatus stays unreviewed: no reuse rights; terms not reviewed. Questions are human-reviewed Independent Factual Summaries in original wording that link to the page; no text or images are reused.

sources.name: U.S. Department of Justice (U.S. Attorney's Offices, Florida)
sources.notes: Approved 2026-11-24 by the project owner under https://www.justice.gov/legalpolicies (updated 2026-07-09): information on DOJ websites is public domain 'unless otherwise indicated' and may be copied and distributed without permission. Scope: release TEXT only (title, teaser, facts). Excluded: third-party photos/graphics, DOJ seals/logos (written permission required), any implied endorsement. Only Florida U.S. Attorney's Office releases, convictions only by default; each question is still approved by a human. Original DOJ headlines are NOT displayed (canDisplayOriginalTitle false): rights would allow it, but headlines can name private individuals; the owner may enable it after a privacy review.
sources.attribution: U.S. Department of Justice, U.S. Attorney's Office (press release)

sources.name: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission
sources.attribution: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission, Division of Law Enforcement weekly report
sources.notes: Official Florida state agency. Registered 2026-11-24 for the official-report pilot; rights and every access operation remain UNKNOWN until the owner reviews them. GovDelivery (content.govdelivery.com) is a shared platform: only /accounts/FLFFWCC/ belongs to this source. The Division of Law Enforcement weekly reports ended in March 2025 (historical inventory only). Never import FWC images, logos or third-party photos.

access.robots: Checked 2026-11-24: myfwc.com robots.txt allows User-agent * with Content-Signal search=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference (no ai-input signal); content.govdelivery.com/robots.txt returns 404. Not a grant.
access.findings: Research 2026-11-24 (not an approval). Weekly reports are GovDelivery bulletins (one bulletin = many short incident paragraphs grouped by region and county; officers are named, subjects usually are not). myfwc.com answered automated clients with a Cloudflare challenge (403) during earlier research: never bypass it. No reuse terms for bulletin text were found; Florida public-records status (ch. 119 F.S.) and any copyright position were NOT verified. Public records requests: https://myfwc.com/contact/public-records-requests/. Open decisions for the owner: fetch, store, extractFacts, aiProcessing, publishSummary; reproduceOriginal and useMedia stay denied in practice (no rights review).

sources.name: Flagler County Sheriff's Office
sources.notes: Official Florida county agency. Registered 2026-11-24 for the official-report pilot; rights and every access operation remain UNKNOWN until the owner reviews them. Releases name arrestees, list prior arrests and embed mugshots: none of that is ever stored or shown. Commander's Reports and records pages are raw police records and are not ingested.

access.robots: Checked 2026-11-24: robots.txt allows User-agent * with Content-Signal search=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference (no ai-input signal) and disallows AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, CCBot, Google-Extended, …). Not a grant.
access.findings: Research 2026-11-24 (not an approval). News releases are WordPress pages (/news/<slug>/) with a 'Date:' line, the release text, a mugshot caption and a release number; /feed/ returned an empty RSS channel, so there is no reviewed discovery channel. No terms of use or reuse statement was found (privacy page only; it cites Florida's public-records law, ch. 119 F.S., for e-mail). Copyright/public-records status of release text was NOT verified. Records: https://flaglersheriff.com/contact-us/records/. Open decisions for the owner: fetch, store, extractFacts, aiProcessing, publishSummary.
